# pvecli tag color

Manage color palette.

## add

Add a color to the palette.

```text
pvecli tag color add [NAME] [HEX_COLOR] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NAME` | Color name (e.g. 'Cyan'). |
| `HEX_COLOR` | Hex color code (e.g. 00bcd4). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-f`, `--font VALUE` | Font color: white or black. |

## remove

Remove a color from the palette.

```text
pvecli tag color remove [NAME]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NAME` | Color name to remove. |

## init

Initialize the color palette file with default colors.

```text
pvecli tag color init [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-f`, `--force` | Overwrite existing file. |

## list

List all colors in the palette.

```text
pvecli tag color list
```
